Program Framework

## Page 3

The Magic Bus Young Girls Empowerment Programme aims to provide life skills, employability education, and placement opportunities in entry-level grey
collar jobs within the service sector. This program is strategically located across five key operational hubs in India, namely Coimbatore, Indore, Raipur, Delhi
(Shaheen Baug), and Chandigarh. The programme targets young undergraduate girls aged 18 to 25, with a program duration from March 2023 to March
2026.
Visualizing our expansive reach: This map illustrates the 'Centre Location' for our Outreach Program Framework, highlighting key operational hubs across India, including Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai,
Hyderabad, Jaipur, Kolkata, Lucknow, and Mumbai.

## Page 4

Overview
The Girls Empowerment Programme has made significant strides in Phase II, running from April 2025 to December 2025. The programme set ambitious
enrollment and placement targets across five locations. As of the third quarter, enrollment figures have reached an impressive 87% of the target, with a total of
1,589 young women enrolled. The training and placement phase has also shown notable success, with 769 individuals placed, achieving an 87% placement
rate.

## Page 5

Enrolment – Target vs Achieved
The programme's enrollment performance across the five locations has surpassed expectations in several areas:
• Coimbatore: Target - 365, Achieved - 369 (101%)
• Indore: Target - 365, Achieved - 417 (114%)
• Raipur: Target - 365, Achieved - 271 (74%)
• Delhi (Shaheen Baug): Target - 365, Achieved - 335 (92%)
• Chandigarh: Target - 365, Achieved - 220 (60%)
This demonstrates a strong mobilization and outreach effort, particularly in Coimbatore and Indore, where the targets have been exceeded.

## Page 6

Enrolled and Dropout
The enrolment data also reveals dropout rates which have been managed effectively to maintain high participation levels:
• Coimbatore: Enrolled - 369, Dropout - 2
• Indore: Enrolled - 417, Dropout - 8
• Raipur: Enrolled - 271, Dropout - 13
• Delhi (Shaheen Baug): Enrolled - 335, Dropout - 18
• Chandigarh: Enrolled - 220, Dropout - 26
Efforts to minimize dropout rates have included pre-enrollment counseling and continuous mentoring.

## Page 7

Gender Ratio
The programme has also focused on maintaining a balanced gender ratio, which is crucial for achieving its empowerment goals. The current gender
distribution is:
• Coimbatore: Female - 216, Male - 153
• Indore: Female - 286, Male - 131
• Raipur: Female - 203, Male - 68
• Delhi (Shaheen Baug): Female - 210, Male - 125
• Chandigarh: Female - 157, Male - 63
This distribution highlights the programme's effectiveness in reaching its target demographic of young women.

## Page 8

Challenges and Mitigation
The programme has encountered several challenges, which have been addressed with targeted mitigation strategies:
• Mobilization & Enrolment Challenges: In Indore, there was initial hesitancy from families to allow their children to join the workforce. Mitigation
involved pre-enrollment counseling for participants and families, along with continuous mentoring and flexible batch timings.
• Participation Challenges: Irregular attendance was noted due to household responsibilities, health issues, or seasonal work. This was mitigated
through regular attendance tracking and motivational sessions.
• Job Readiness Challenges: There was a mismatch between participants' qualifications and the skills required for certain jobs. The programme
addressed this through focused employability training and market orientation sessions.

## Page 9

Impact Stories
Mohini Tiwari
Age: 19
Educational Qualification: 12th
Organization: Taurus BPO Pvt. Ltd.
Position: Customer Care Executive
Salary: INR 15,704
Date of Joining: 26-03-2026
Mohini Tiwari, from Indore, exemplifies determination and discipline. Despite starting with limited opportunities, she secured a role at Taurus BPO Pvt. Ltd.,
where she is a dedicated Customer Care Executive earning INR 15,704 monthly. She has always aimed to support her family and become independent, and
her journey reflects the power of hard work and perseverance.

## Page 10

Supporting career development, this impact story highlights a beneficiary at TAURUS BPC, underscoring the tangible outcomes of our program in fostering professional growth and opportunity.
Shrasthi Solanki
Age: 20
Educational Qualification: 12th
Organization: Altruist Technologies Pvt Ltd.

## Page 11

Position: Customer Care Executive
Salary: INR 10,500 per month
Shrasthi Solanki, a young woman from Indore, has proven that hard work and a positive mindset can lead to success. Working at Altruist Technologies, she
earns INR 10,500 monthly, marking the beginning of a promising career. Her resilience and dedication are inspiring, as she continues to contribute to her
household income and inspire others.

## Page 12

Shrashti, a determined young woman from Indore, exemplifies how hard work and a positive mindset lead to success. With support, she secured a position at Altruist Technologies, demonstrating that even a
modest beginning can be a stepping stone towards a future built with dignity and dedication.
Dheerendra Singh
Age: 20
Educational Qualification: Undergraduate
Organization: Reliance Trends
Position: Customer Service Associate
Salary: INR 13,171 per month
Date of Joining: 06-01-2026
Dheerendra Singh's journey from Indore is marked by resilience and responsibility. He secured a position at Reliance Trends, earning INR 13,171 monthly.
His story is not just about professional success but also personal strength. As the elder brother, Dheerendra has always been a role model for his sibling,
showcasing that no dream is too small.

## Page 13

Dheerendra Singh, a beneficiary of our impact story initiatives, showcases his professional journey, empowered by the opportunities provided.

## Page 14

Photos
Mobilization
Magic Bus India Foundation's mobilization efforts are exemplified in this image from Zee Indore, showcasing engagement with community members in New Palasia, Indore.

## Page 15

Young women actively participate in a "Mobilization" initiative supported by the Magic Bus India Foundation in Indore. Their engagement signifies a commitment to outreach and community development,
fostering opportunities for growth and positive change.
Training

## Page 16

Empowering young minds, this training session in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, provides crucial skills and knowledge, fostering growth and future opportunities for participants. Your support directly fuels these
transformative learning experiences.

## Page 17

Empowering futures: Students in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, engage in computer-based training, a vital step towards securing employment through our 'Jobs + Post Placement' initiative.

## Page 18

Empowering the next generation of digital citizens, this training session in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, focuses on crucial cybersecurity education, equipping participants with essential knowledge to navigate the
online world safely.
